newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Tokobank says to get $85 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Tokobank says to get $85 mln credit.

text.p: One of Russia's biggest banks, AKB Tokobank, said on Friday it would sign a $85 million one-year credit contract with a group of European, Asian and U.S. banks on Tuesday.
The credit, which can be prolonged for another year, is granted at LIBOR plus 4.5 percent annual, Tokobank said in a statement.

The creditor banks include Bank Austria, Creditanstalt-Bankverein, Berliner Bank, BHF-Bank AG, Bayerische Landesbank, Bayerische Vereinsbank, Banque Francaise de Commerce Exterieur, Union Bank of Switzerland, Seoul Bank, American Express Bank and Bankers Trust International, it said.
